evals.name: agent-api-binding-drift
evals.prompt: Review the Agent API changes across Rust, bindings/finstack-ai-python, and bindings/finstack-ai-wasm. I want to know if the Python stubs, WASM names, public-item inventory, and tests all match the canonical Rust API.
evals.expected_output: A binding parity review that lists every mirrored surface checked, flags missing stubs/exports/public-item entries, and recommends targeted check-public-items/conformance/WASM verification.
